subject: Vendor onboarding: legal & security checklist + PO steps
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acme-corp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding info needed for Acme P.O.

Hi Rishi,

We're ready to move forward with Redwood for the pilot, and Procurement needs a handful of items before they can issue a PO: a countersigned DPA (or DocuSign envelope), a current SOC 2 report or public URL to it, and your up-to-date subprocessor list. They also want your vendor setup form filled out so Finance can create a vendor record.

Could you send the DPA and the subprocessor CSV and confirm preferred invoicing contact and pay terms? If you have a DocuSign link that speeds things up, that would be ideal.

Thanks — happy to coordinate a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Elaine Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
elaine.park@acme-corp.com

[Attachment: Acme_PO_Template.docx (referenced, not attached)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acme-corp.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding info needed for Acme P.O.

Hi Elaine — thanks for the note and congrats on the pilot approval.

On the items you requested:
- DPA: attached for signature (Redwood_DPA_v3.2.pdf). We can DocuSign if you prefer — see link below.
- SOC 2: public copy is here: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/compliance/SOC2_Report_2026Q1.pdf
- Subprocessors: attached CSV (Subprocessor_List_2026-07.csv) with categories and countries.
- Vendor setup: attached form (Procurement_Onboarding_Form.xlsx). Please complete the highlighted fields on page 2 and return; we can also accept the completed PDF if that's easier.

Invoicing: please send the PO to invoices@redwoodinference.com. Our default payment terms are Net 30. If Finance has a template for ACH wiring or requires a specific remittance ID, include that on the PO and we'll confirm.

DocuSign envelope for DPA (optional): https://www.docusign.net/envelope/1234abcd5678efgh

If Procurement would like a short checklist to attach to their vendor packet, I've included one below for convenience. Happy to jump on a 15-min call with your procurement lead to walk through.

Checklist for PO issuance (suggested):
1) Completed Procurement_Onboarding_Form.xlsx returned
2) Signed DPA (DocuSign or signed PDF)
3) PO issued to invoices@redwoodinference.com with remittance info
4) Confirmed SOC 2 link and subprocessor list received

Best,

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Rishi — received everything. A couple of quick items from Legal/Procurement:
1) We'll sign via DocuSign; please ensure the contact on the envelope is "Redwood Legal" (legal@redwoodinference.com) so countersign is routed correctly.
2) The subprocessor CSV looks good but can you confirm whether the analytics vendor processes EU data? If so, provide the EU data transfer safeguards you rely on.
3) PO will go to invoices@redwoodinference.com, Net 30. Expect the PO number in 24–48 hours after our vendor record is created.

We may need a one-page data flow diagram for the security packet — can you provide a simple PNG or PDF? If not, a short bullet summary of data types and where they are processed will suffice.

Best,
